content:
Foldable screens often develop more noticeable creases over time, but Apple's Kate Bergeron says the iPhone Duo's foldable display features a replaceable protective layer that helps mitigate this issue.

The "protective layer" on the iPhone Duo's foldable screen can be replaced over time to keep it looking like new.

Following the iPhone Duo's launch last month, Apple executives sat down for an interview to explain how the company deliberately pushed to improve durability and reduce the creasing that has plagued other folding phones.

As part of those efforts, the iPhone Duo appears to have a unique design feature to ensure a "like new" experience for years to come: a replaceable protective layer on the foldable screen.

Here's what Apple's VP of Hardware Engineering Kate Bergeron had to say during an interview on TikTok with @angiertutorials:

You can watch the full clip on TikTok.

Apple mentions this "protective layer" in the iPhone Duo's AppleCare estimated repair pricing sheet. As discovered by Quinn Nelson, replacing the protective layer costs $19 under AppleCare coverage. The cost without AppleCare has not yet been announced.

So, if you're worried about spending $2,000+ on an iPhone Duo only to find the screen crease getting more pronounced over time, it looks like Apple has a solution in place.

Are you worried about creasing on the iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
